OverviewThe NZXT Gold Core is an ATX 3.1, fully modular PSU with 80 PLUS Gold and Cybenetics Platinum efficiency, A+/A++ noise rating, and a 12V-2x6 PCIe 5.1 connector. Built for modern GPUs, it delivers clean, quiet power with easy cable management for performance PCs.
ATX 3.1 Certified, PCIE 5.1 Ready: Supports next-gen GPUs with a dual-color 12V-2x6 connector for safe, stable, and efficient power delivery—ideal for modern NVIDIA graphics cards.
80 PLUS Gold & Cybenetics Platinum Efficiency: Delivers energy-efficient, stable performance to reduce heat and power draw, even under demanding loads.
Whisper-Quiet Operation: Cybenetics noise certified for near-silent performance: A++ for C750 and C850 (<15 dBA), A+ for C1000 (15–20 dBA).
Ready for AMD & NVIDIA GPUs: Compatible with most GPUs using a 12V-2x6 cable or up to three 8-pin PCIe cables.
FDB Fan with Zero RPM Mode: 135 mm fluid dynamic bearing fan stays quiet and efficient, with Zero RPM mode during light workloads for silent operation.
Premium 105°C-Rated Capacitors: High-quality components ensure stable, long-lasting performance across a wide range of system loads.
Fully Modular with Embossed Cables: Use only the cables you need with a clean, compact design and durable, flexible cables for easy routing.
Built-In Protections & 7-Year Warranty: Includes essential safety features and a dual-colored 12V-2x6 connector rated for 105°C, all backed by a 7-year warranty.
Essential Power for Modern Builds
NZXT Gold Core delivers 80 PLUS Gold efficiency with full ATX 3.1 support for stable performance. Its modular design keeps cable management easy and your build clean, with broad compatibility across cases and components.
ATX 3.1 & PCIe 5.1 ReadyMeets ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 standards with a 600W 12V-2x6 connector for high-performance GPUs. Delivers stable power with improved efficiency and voltage control — ideal for top-tier NVIDIA and AMD cards under heavy load.Ready for Any GPUSupports high-performance GPUs with a 12V-2x6 connector and dual-color housing that shows when the connection is secure. Includes up to three 8-pin PCIe cables for legacy support — offering flexibility across a wide range of powerful NVIDIA and AMD builds.
Quiet When it Counts135 mm fluid dynamic bearing fan stays silent under light loads with Zero RPM mode—automatically stopping the fan when cooling isn’t needed.
Stable Under Pressure105°C-rated capacitors deliver steady, reliable power—even under heavy loads.Fully ModularEmbossed cables with included combs help keep your build and cables clean.Sized for Easy Builds150 mm length fits easily in most PC cases, helping keep your build clean and straightforward.
Peace of Mind
Includes overcurrent, overvoltage, and shortcircuit protection—plus a 7-year warranty.

Frequently Asked Questions
Does this PSU use 100% Japanese capacitors?
Gold Core PSUs use premium capacitors from Taiwan, another region known for world-class manufacturing. Each unit is tested to ensure stable power and long-lasting reliability, even under demanding use.
How do I know which PSU wattage I need for my build?
The right wattage depends on your components, especially your CPU and GPU. Too little power can cause stability issues, while too much means paying for capacity you’ll never use. For the best efficiency, choose a power supply that’s roughly double your system’s peak load.
Is Gold Core compatible with the latest GPUs and CPUs?
Yes. Gold Core PSUs are ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 compliant, so they’re ready for next-gen GPUs with the 12V-2x6 connector. They also include PCIe cables for older graphics cards, along with all the standard connectors needed for the latest AMD and Intel CPUs.
